pages.title: Full Steam Ahead
pages.text: Learn the linked demands of heat, water and boiler size before scaling the factory.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow the boiler Ponder scene. The native boiler must report active output and the attached engine must transmit nonzero rotation.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Attach Steam Engines to a sufficiently sized Fluid Tank boiler; supply water and heat, then add shafts. Generate rotation; goggles reveal the limiting boiler requirement.
